title: The Phones That Knew the Time
logline: From the world of AFTER THE HUM: the night before every phone in Meridian screamed, 17-year-old repair apprentice Jun Arai pulls the batteries out of a tray of broken phones and locks up her kiosk. That night every dead screen lights up at once, warm to the touch, flashing the same time every seventeen seconds: 7:17. Her watch says 11:40. The next morning, at exactly 7:17, every phone in the city screamed.

narrator_voice: Low, intimate and direct; restrained emotion and dry humor.
